name: Sarah Chen
role: External Project Manager (facilitator on this engagement)

behavioral_observations.observation: When the room moves toward discomfort late in a meeting, tends to offer a Friday deadline ('plan by next Friday', 'let me think about what that means for the steering on Friday') — the offer functions as a release-valve that closes the discomfort without resolving it.
Under pressure from an unexpected internal-to-vendor alignment, defends the scope line by closing space for the internal voice rather than by holding both — observed once, worth watching.

notes: The user's own contact-card. Kept so meeting-cards can reference the facilitator by id (consistent attendee handling) and so the user can read their own patterns over time without re-grepping meeting-cards.
